The shop calls us. Not you. That is the whole trick.

The single thing that makes a claim go wrong is a shop that starts work before calling. Then it is a reimbursement argument instead of a covered repair. So the rule is simple and worth saying out loud once.
Any ASE-certified shop. Before they touch anything, they call Ascent at 866-660-7003 with contract {{{CONTRACT}}}. Ascent authorizes. Ascent pays the shop directly. You pay $100 and drive home.

HOW A CLAIM GOES
1: Take the {{{VEHICLE}}} to any ASE-certified shop
2: Shop calls Ascent at 866-660-7003 before work starts
3: Ascent authorizes and pays the shop
4: You pay the $100 deductible. Done.

If a shop says they do not work with service contracts, that is a shop choice, not a coverage problem. Openbay+ will find you one that does, usually closer than you think.

Find an ASE shop on Openbay -> {{{OPENBAY_URL}}}
Good to know before you need it. Terrible to learn on a flatbed.

Rental reimbursement up to $250 per claim and trip interruption up to $450 are in there too. Ask Ascent on the call.
